evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/lib/auth-context.tsx:142-152 — in checkSession(), the bearer-token path treats ANY non-ok /api/v1/users/me response as a definitive auth failure: `if (meResp.ok) {...return;} clearStoredSession();` runs on every non-200 (including a transient 5xx), wiping the stored session and falling through to the cookie probe, which then sets user=null on a server blip.

Inconsistent with refreshSession() in the SAME file (auth-context.tsx:225-237), which for the identical /users/me call only clears on a definitive auth failure — `if (meResp.status === 401 || meResp.status === 403) { clearStoredSession(); setUser(null); }` — and explicitly documents (lines 230-233) that 'Any other status (5xx, etc.) is treated as transient: leave optimistic state intact'. checkSession lacks that status guard.

Impact: a single 5xx / gateway hiccup on /users/me during the mount-time checkSession() spuriously logs a form-login user out (token discarded, header flips to 'Sign in'), where refreshSession would have preserved the session. Fix: gate checkSession's clearStoredSession() on `meResp.status === 401 || meResp.status === 403` to match refreshSession's documented transient-vs-definitive policy.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/listings/sections/ListingHeader.tsx:6-16 and frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/agency/AgencyListings.tsx:373-378 each define a LOCAL formatPrice that hardcodes the locale to 'en-US' in `new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency, ... })`, so the price number grouping/format ignores the active next-intl locale on a 4-language portal (sk, cs, de, en).

Diverges from the canonical helper frontend/apps/reality-web/src/lib/format.ts:48 `formatPrice(value, locale, options)`, which takes the locale precisely so output follows the user's language; ListingCard.tsx:106 uses it correctly (`formatPrice(listing.price, locale, { currency: listing.currency })`). The two local copies are both a locale/i18n gap and a duplication smell (three parallel formatPrice implementations).

Impact (low): on sk/cs/de locales the listing-detail header price and the agency-listings table price render with en-US number conventions instead of the active locale, inconsistent with the locale-aware price shown everywhere ListingCard is used. Fix: delete the two local formatPrice helpers and call lib/format.ts formatPrice with the component's active locale (useLocale()/useTranslations locale).
